output.one_liner: Netlify is a cloud platform for deploying and managing web applications via REST API with official MCP support.

auth.notes: OAuth2 is the primary authentication method with both Authorization Code and Implicit grant flows supported. Personal Access Tokens (PAT) can also be used as Bearer tokens in the Authorization header.

evidence.snippet: To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header
Since Netlify is an OAuth2 provider, you can use this API to build services

access.notes: Any user can create a free Netlify account and immediately generate personal access tokens for API access without payment or approval.

evidence.snippet: To generate a personal access token select New access token
Personal access tokens A credential tied to your personal account
